datesNote: Dates drop at the start of the spring semester. Follow @sbuthetataurush so you don't miss the first event.

faq.a: Theta Tau is a co-ed professional engineering fraternity that values brotherhood, profession, and service. You can find our brothers at job conferences, local beach clean-ups, or building houses for Habitat for Humanity.

faq.q: Can I rush as a freshman?
faq.a: Only second-semester freshmen qualify for an interview. However, first-semester freshmen are always welcome at our events and can rush again in the following semesters.

faq.q: What is rush, and how do I rush?
faq.a: Rush is a two week period where rushes and brothers get to know each other. There are 6 events total, including professional and fun team bonding activities. To rush, all you have to do is show up to our events and be yourself!

faq.q: How do I get an interview?
faq.a: Attend at least 3 events, with one including an informational session. You must have a GPA (at least a second semester freshman). CEAS major preferred.
After receiving a bid, there is a 6 week process (equivalent to a 4 credit class) designed to instill the core values of Theta Tau and help new members develop lifelong connections with all brothers.
Contact our rush chairs or DM @sbuthetataurush!!
